messages:
Alex: opened a PR to consolidate private/VPC install snippets into one 'sealed-site' page to reduce duplication. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302
Morgan: sweet. can you paste the HSM example here for a quick look?
Alex: main PKCS11 env examples:
```bash
# Linux appliances may use /usr/lib or /usr/lib64 depending on distro
export PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/libykcs11.so  # fallback path
export PKCS11_MODULE_ALT=/usr/lib64/libykcs11.so  # SUSE/appliance builds
export PKCS11_TOKEN_LABEL=redwood-hsm
```
Zara: add note that YubiHSM v2 commonly uses slot=1 (not 0). also mention testing with `pkcs11-tool -L`.
SRE-Jen: add MTU/fragmentation tips for IPSec tunnels: check `ip link` MTU and enable MSS clamping on edge NAT. small snippet suggestion: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` and set tunnel mtu to 1400 when needed.
Alex: will add an operations note box for that.
Samir: customers ask for a proxy-aware SDK preflight. dropping a Node + Python example into PR would help.
Alex: draft Node snippet:```js
// proxy-aware KMS preflight
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const { HttpsProxyAgent } = require('https-proxy-agent');
await fetch('https://kms.internal.local/health', { agent: new HttpsProxyAgent(process.env.HTTP_PROXY) });
```
Alex: Python snippet:```py
import requests
proxies = { 'https': 'http://proxy:3128' }
requests.get('https://kms.internal.local/health', proxies=proxies, verify=False)
```
Morgan: also include a one-liner for ops: `curl -x http://proxy:3128 --insecure https://kms.internal.local/health`
Zara: nftables example would be nice; many docs only show iptables.
Alex: added quick nftables vs iptables sample:```bash
# iptables
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 10.0.0.5 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
# nftables
nft add rule ip filter output ip daddr 10.0.0.5 tcp dport 443 accept
```
SRE-Jen: include persistence tip: `nft list ruleset > /etc/nftables.conf` or use systemd unit on Debian.
docs-bot: docs CI: linkcheck skipped for internal URLs, build OK :white_check_mark:
Samir: for air-gapped installs include checksum + GPG verify snippet so customers can validate bundles during cutover.
Alex: adding a 3-step offline checklist: 1) checksum verify (`sha256sum`), 2) gpg --verify signatures, 3) kube manifest dry-run.
Morgan: FYI a migration guide anchor is broken (`#legacy-keys`), update to `#legacy-key-migration` in the cross-ref.
Alex: assigned follow-ups: Zara = confirm HSM lib paths & slot note; Samir = commit SDK snippets; Morgan = fix anchor; SRE-Jen = add MTU and persistence tips. I'll amend PR and set WIP until reviews done.
Zara: testing on SUSE VM tomorrow, will comment on PR.
Samir: pushed Node+Python snippets to the branch, PTAL.
Morgan: if anchor change causes conflicts I'll open a tiny follow-up PR.
Alex: thanks all :thumbsup: will ping when ready for final review.
